verdict.rationale: A tax agency that publishes machine-readable open data could plausibly offer an interactive API reference, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no such reference: every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returns 404. The only programmatic surface is a keyless Socrata SODA query on data.texas.gov, which is a host-platform data endpoint, not a documented interactive reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
